title: hold supplier verifier input
description: Run a background check on one domain, compare an unfamiliar sender domain against a supplier's known domain, or watch a list of real domains for registered look-alikes.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'background' checks one domain on its own. 'copycat' compares domain against knownDomain. 'watch' finds registered look-alikes of every domain in domains.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Domain to check (background), or the unfamiliar sender domain (copycat). No scheme, e.g. "example.com".

businessName.title: Business name
businessName.description: The supplier's name on file, compared against the site's title (background mode only).

knownDomain.title: Known domain
knownDomain.description: The supplier's domain on file, to compare domain against (copycat mode only).

domains.title: Domains to watch
domains.description: Real domains (watch mode only). Each gets about 80 look-alikes generated (typos, hyphens, look-alike letters, other endings, added words like -billing), and every one someone has registered comes back with its age.
